# Vue 3 and Vue Router 4 (vendored test fixture)

Browser ES module builds from the npm packages, unmodified:

| File | Package |
| --- | --- |
| `vue.js` | `vue@3.5.13` (`dist/vue.esm-browser.prod.js`, with the template compiler) |
| `vue-router.js` | `vue-router@4.5.0` (`dist/vue-router.esm-browser.prod.js`) |

MIT (see `LICENSE`). Used only by pageon's tests, loaded through an import map.
